name: Synthetic Starlink-style MEME (EME2000)
_note: Synthetic suite written by analysis/od/scripts/synthetic-fixtures.mjs: SGP4 truth in the operator layout, and a reference element set standing in for a third-party fit (truth with the mean anomaly moved about 0.02 deg, 2.4-3.2 km along track). The gate is the same: our RMS must beat the reference RMS, and the reference scored on our TEME states must land within referenceRmsMaxKm. The real SpaceX ephemerides and the CelesTrak SupGP rows paired with them run when SDN_MODULES_PRIVATE_FIXTURES is set.
